//: Config do Claude Code para projetos scaffolded. Merge no .claude/settings.json existente via install (Install-JsonBaselineItem). O merge e 3-way: arrays preservam o que voce adicionou, entao hooks proprios aqui sobrevivem ao reinstall. O command e' uma dispatch-line portavel (J4) gerada por Get-HookDispatchCommand (tools/hooks-lint.ps1) -- FONTE UNICA, travada por teste: com pwsh roda o .ps1, sem pwsh cai p/ o .sh (degradacao consciente). curation-nudge/peer-heartbeat rodam em UserPromptSubmit (1x/turno), NAO em PostToolUse:Write|Edit. Os scripts ainda aceitam PostToolUse para nao quebrar projetos com settings.json antigo. GATE NO sh (2026-08-14): subir o pwsh custa ~274ms e em quase todo disparo o .ps1 so lia um arquivo e saia calado -- o teste POSIX em $3 antecipa esse `return` sem pagar o interpretador. complementary-repo-guard: pula quando .claude/complementary-repos.psd1 nao existe (456->81ms por Write/Edit, medido em projeto recem-criado); desde 2026-10-17 dispara tambem em Bash/PowerShell, e o gate e' o que mantem esse custo fora de quem nao registrou repo. curation-nudge em UserPromptSubmit: pula enquanto o marcador de cooldown tiver <30min (=1800s do $script:CooldownSeconds; 620->124ms, medido no mesmo projeto). SessionStart NAO leva gate: la o cooldown e' ignorado de proposito. Gate e' FAIL-OPEN -- na duvida o pwsh sobe. POWERSHELL (2026-10-18): o GitHub Copilot CLI le estes hooks e, no Windows, roda o `powershell` no lugar do `command` (sem sh e sem CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR la); o Claude Code ignora o campo. Gerado por Get-HookPowerShellCommand (tools/hooks-lint.ps1), travado por teste.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ ! -f "$3" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; fi; if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/complementary-repo-guard.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/complementary-repo-guard.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/complementary-repos.psd1"

sh -c 'if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.sh"

sh -c 'if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.sh"

sh -c 'if [ -n "$(find "$3" -mmin -30 2>/dev/null)" ]; then cat >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0; fi; if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/curation-nudge.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/.cache/nudge-state.json"

sh -c 'raw=$(cat); id=$(printf "%s" "$raw" | sed -n "s/.*\"session_id\" *: *\"\([A-Za-z0-9_.-]*\)\".*/\1/p"); if [ -n "$id" ] && [ -n "$(find "$3/$id.json" -mmin -5 2>/dev/null)" ]; then exit 0; fi; if command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf "%s" "$raw" | exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "$1"; else printf "%s" "$raw" | exec bash "$2"; fi' _ "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.ps1" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/peer-heartbeat.sh" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/.cache/peers"
